---
name: Feature request
about: Something you'd like Flapwire to do
labels: enhancement
---

**What you're trying to do**

The actual problem, not the proposed solution. "I'm testing checkout flows on a flaky line and want to fail the build when it doesn't recover" beats "add a fail-on-error flag".

**What you've tried so far**

Existing flags, profiles, workarounds. If something almost works but for one missing piece, that piece is often the right thing to add.

**Where you think this fits**

The masterplan has a rough phase order — config files & admin API in v0.2, UI in v0.3, CI integration in v0.4. If your idea naturally belongs in one of those, say so; it makes scheduling easier.
